g.text: Poll (each repository)
Query 1: read the requirement issues
and their sub-issues (no pull request)
Select the open sub-issues
with a cumin/status/* label (pure function)
Query 2: read the open pull requests
that close the selected sub-issues
yes
a sub-issue is selected?
no
Build one snapshot from the two reads
Name the candidates of request the split
and request the implementation in the order
of the starts, none without a free slot
(pure function)
Read the actor of the newest
cumin/status/ready (1 point), and the
permission of a person (1 REST call)
the actor is a Maintainer?
yes
no
Store the login of the Maintainer in the snapshot
Store "not a Maintainer" in the snapshot,
log and notify once
for this ready event
yes
a candidate is left, and fewer
Maintainer candidates than free slots?
no
Decision (pure function, no I/O)
Collect candidates of request a conflict resolution
- open sub-issues with cumin/status/checking
- the pull request is CONFLICTING
(UNKNOWN and MERGEABLE are no candidates)
Collect candidates of request the review
- open sub-issues with cumin/status/checking
- the pull request is not CONFLICTING
- every required check passed on the head commit
of the pull request
Collect candidates of request a check fix
- open sub-issues with cumin/status/checking
- the pull request is not CONFLICTING
- a required check failed on the head commit
of the pull request
Collect candidates of stop for missing checks
- open sub-issues with cumin/status/checking
- the pull request is not CONFLICTING
- no required check failed, and a required check
has not reported on the head commit
- checks_wait_time is over, counted from the later
one of the label time and the head commit time
(the time of the poll is an input value)
- or no open pull request closes the issue, and
checks_wait_time is over since the label time
Count the issues in progress
- requirement issues with cumin/status/planning
- open sub-issues with implementing,
checking, or reviewing
Compute the free slots
max_issues_in_progress - issues in progress
Collect candidates of request the split
- open requirement issues
- with cumin/status/ready
- every blocked-by issue closed
- a Maintainer added the newest cumin/status/ready
(not a Maintainer, or not read: skipped)
Collect candidates of request the acceptance check
- open requirement issues
- with cumin/status/implementing
or cumin/status/awaiting-plan-review
- one or more sub-issues, all closed
- no acceptance check comment after the last close
- the follow-up notes written
Collect candidates of request the implementation
- open sub-issues
- with cumin/status/ready
- every blocked-by issue closed
- a Maintainer added the newest cumin/status/ready
(not a Maintainer, or not read: skipped)
Sort the candidates of request the split,
request the acceptance check, and request the implementation
by priority label (highest first; no label last),
then by issue number,
and keep as many as the free slots
Collect candidates of start the merge
- open sub-issues with cumin/status/awaiting-merge-decision
- an APPROVED review of a person
on the head commit of the pull request
Collect candidates of send back for changes
- open sub-issues with cumin/status/awaiting-merge-decision
and without cumin/status/ready
- a CHANGES_REQUESTED review of a person
on the head commit of the pull request,
submitted after the last
cumin/status/awaiting-merge-decision of the issue
Collect candidates of request a conflict resolution
while a Maintainer decides
- open sub-issues with cumin/status/awaiting-merge-decision
and without cumin/status/ready
- the pull request is CONFLICTING
(UNKNOWN and MERGEABLE are no candidates)
Collect copy the labels to the pull request
- each open pull request that closes an issue
- its cumin/status/* and risk/* differ
from the issue in this snapshot
Return the list of actions
(request a conflict resolution, request the review,
request a check fix or stop for failed checks,
stop for missing checks, request the split and
request the implementation, start the merge,
send back for changes, request a conflict resolution
while a Maintainer decides, copy the labels to
the pull request, in this order)
Apply (in the order of the list)
request a conflict resolution: change the label to cumin/status/implementing,
then ask the Implementer to resolve the conflict
in the same session
request the review: change the label to cumin/status/reviewing
fix requests below the limit?
yes
no
request a check fix: count one more, change the label to
cumin/status/implementing, and request
a fix in the same session
stop for failed checks:
hand it back to a Maintainer
stop for missing checks: change the label to
cumin/status/awaiting-decision, then
hand it back to a Maintainer with
the head commit, the required checks that
have not reported, and the time waited
(with no open pull request: that fact,
and the time waited)
request the split: change the label to cumin/status/planning,
then ask the Planner to split
request the implementation: change the label to cumin/status/implementing,
then ask the Implementer
If a label does not change,
try again at the next poll
start the merge: read the permission of each reviewer,
and when the latest review of a Maintainer approves
the head commit, run the merge step
send back for changes: read the permission of each reviewer,
and when the latest review of a Maintainer requests
changes on the head commit, after the last
cumin/status/awaiting-merge-decision, change the label to
cumin/status/implementing, then ask the Implementer
to address that review in the same session
request a conflict resolution while a Maintainer decides:
when start the merge and send back for changes
did not take the issue at this poll,
change the label to cumin/status/implementing,
then ask the Implementer to resolve the conflict
in the same session
copy the labels to the pull request copies the labels of the issue as this poll
read them. A label that this poll or the end of
a run (wait for the checks) changed reaches the pull request
at the next poll.
copy the labels to the pull request: make the labels of the pull request
the same as the issue
